tagline: Leading global financial services firm with strong regulatory capital position
hero_kpi_rationale: Key financial strength metric for a G-SIB, 6.8% YoY increase reflecting enhanced loss-absorption capacity

kpis.name: External TLAC
kpis.explanation: Total capacity to absorb losses at point of failure
kpis.description: External loss-absorption capacity required for U.S. G-SIBs, comprising CET1, AT1 capital, and eligible LTD

kpis.name: Eligible LTD
kpis.explanation: Long-term debt eligible for TLAC requirements
kpis.description: Long-term debt eligible for TLAC requirements with minimum one-year maturity

kpis.name: Stress Capital Buffer
kpis.explanation: Capital surcharge requirement determined by Federal Reserve stress test
kpis.description: Mandatory capital surcharge based on Federal Reserve CCAR stress test results, replacing the 2.5% CET1 buffer
kpis.signal: Reduction in capital surcharge following stress tests

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence found in the 10-K filing.
